blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: An algorithm is a finite list of exact steps. To compare algorithms we count steps as the input size n grows, not seconds, and describe the shape of that growth.

blocks.title: Common growth, slow to fast
items: $O(n \log n)$: halve, then do n work per level

blocks.title: Big O rules
items: Keep the fastest growing term only
Nested loops multiply, separate loops add

blocks.title: Counting a double loop

blocks.body: Best and worst case describe the input. O, omega and theta describe growth. Plan with the worst case.
